6.333 rsNestedAggregateScopeRequired
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsNestedAggregateScopeRequired is a critical error that will occur when the following conditions are
true:
An aggregate function with an omitted Scope parameter is nested inside another aggregate

function that specifies a Scope parameter.
The expression is located in a cell that belongs to both row and column groups or in a data point

that belongs to both series and category groups.
